1. ESTABLISH - RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA AA (Eligibility only, no signs)
3215-3219 Mission Street (Supervisor District 9) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Raynell
Cooper, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility for the residents and businessowners of 3215-

on nearby RPP blocks. (Parking directly in front currently occupied by a Shared Spaces parklet).

implementation.
